# `aitbc edge database list-dbs`

List edge databases, optionally filtered by island.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc edge database list-dbs [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--island-id` | text | — | no | Filter by island ID |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc edge database list-dbs
```
